<!-- pr-reviewer: ad8f1b6737a637300cf2b71217aad375e4ab3a8a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review. The change affects the EDM path, cavity size checks, and the stock simulation result.

Checks:
- The size law includes the orbit radius. The floor stand uses undersize minus radius.
- The floor and holder checks still apply. A finish vector pattern must reach all four walls.
- The change meets issue #1355. The decision file states the reason and limits.
- No UI files or golden files changed. No build script, workflow, or dependency changed.

Local results against upstream/main `085a4717e2aa2d6463f6f4c4a9c085c044fe2592`:
The trial merge was clean (main is already an ancestor of this head). No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | All 3 stages passed |
| Motion unit tests | 362 passed; 5 ignored |
| App unit tests | 313 passed; 1 ignored |
| Sinker burn tests | 14 passed |
| Sinker orbit tests | 7 passed |
| Sinker undersize tests | 10 passed |
| UI sinker setup test | 1 passed |
| Clippy, app and motion, all targets, warnings denied | Passed |

I ran two temporary mutations in the review worktree:
1. Remove radius from burned width: the finish size test failed (exit 101). Restore the code: the test passed.
2. Restore the old floor stand: the rough stand test failed (exit 101). Restore the code: all 3 motion undersize tests passed.

The source is restored. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested before merge: none.

Limit: these tests use synthetic conditions and a rectangular cavity. They do not test a real EDM control.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
